description: This file defines a Flutter widget class BannerSStyle1, which is a styled banner component for a UI, featuring an image, title, optional subtitle, a discount tag, and a button. It composes other components such as BannerS and BannerDiscountTag, and uses Flutter's material and SVG libraries.
